rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the new surface hides substantial behaviour behind small interfaces: eddb_remote.py (SshTransport + RemoteEddbExtractor batching N channel requests through one ssh process) and eddb.py (fetch_channels/write_channel/is_cached/channel_path over the zarr cache) hide transport, batching, refusal bookkeeping and cache layout behind a handful of names; tokamap_export.py hides four JSON files, two formats and a partition/sign/unit collapse behind export_tokamap_directory. No spread of many one-line wrappers over the same machinery.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: pass — the one duplicate in the tree is named by the plan with the owner to extend and the retirement: imas_ambix/data/tokamap_export.py:147 _cocos_transformation re-implements packages/imas-alambic/src/imas_alambic/transform_engine.py:411 _target_cocos_transformation (same `getattr(node, "cocos_label_transformation")` lookup), and §2 promotes the engine's resolver to public and retires the exporter's copy. Every other shared mechanism is extended in place rather than forked: the probe-angle route stays in imas_ambix/data/description_reader.py read_geometry_table:222 (its probe_angle_source == "description" branch, beside _supply_declared_probe_angles:55), the SELENE reference enters through the existing efit_referee.read_efit_geometry loader seam, and the registry is keyed by machine in imas_ambix/gs/machine_identity.py default_registry:145. The caller census the plan states is complete and correct: identity_for_shot has exactly the three production callers named (artifact_geometry.py:804, machine_selection.py:138, machine_identity.py:245), and default_registry() is fallen back to at exactly the four resolvers named (machine_identity.py:187, 216, 241, 259).
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; every section that touches the remaining surface states its account in its own text: §2 adds one public definition (the engine resolver) and retires the exporter's private copy, stating no public name can be retired in its place; §3 adds two public modules and two refusal families and states they retire nothing because ambix had no remote reader; §6 retires mast_angle_to_canonical with no addition; §7 retires three pin constants, one re-export, one defaulted machine parameter and two silent MAST defaults, adding the pin table, the machine-keyed shot-set table and two record fields. Each addition is paired with a named retirement or a stated reason none can be.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan named and searched the machinery it extends, and every claimed target was confirmed by opening the code: the ambix machine-map schema and loaders (imas_alambic/machine_map.py), the transform engine (packages/imas-alambic/src/imas_alambic/transform_engine.py), the green's-operator forward model (imas_ambix/gs/operator.py build_operator/assemble_pf_currents), the reference-equilibrium seam (imas_ambix/eval/efit_referee.py read_efit_geometry:120, judge_geometry:272), the geometry builder (imas_ambix/worldmodel/equilibrium_labels.py build_geometry_from_arrays:465), the machine-identity registry (imas_ambix/gs/machine_identity.py default_registry:145), and the frozen shot set (imas_ambix/spine_bench/shots.py). grep confirms no prior tokamap exporter and no prior remote EDDB reader exist, so §2 and §3 add genuinely new machinery rather than rebuilding one.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the two layers the plan does add are format boundaries, not wrappers over existing machinery, and it says so: §2 keeps tokamap_export.py out of the loaders because the loaders read the ambix schema and must not learn tokamap's, and §3 states the FAIR-MAST mirror (imas_ambix/data/manifest.py, cli.py) downloads from an object store rather than running a process on a facility host, so the remote reader cannot merge into it. Both justify a new module where neither existing mechanism can be extended.
